Tooltip_craft_YoghurtIncubatorDesc: A Yoghurt Pot wrapped in cloth. Pour in milk steaming from a Hearth's copper and add a yoghurt or a starter; it sets by itself once the milk has cooled to 45 C. Pour from a Hearth within 2 tiles, or carry the milk over in a Wrapped Yoghurt Pot.
Tooltip_craft_StarterCultureCrockDesc: A clay jar or pot under a cloth, for growing a yoghurt starter from wheat and milk when no yoghurt is left to start from. It loads with milk at 35 to 45 C, from a Hearth's copper or a Wrapped Yoghurt Pot. Small enough to stand on a counter or table, or on the floor.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Yog: A wide lidded pot that holds 5 litres. Wrap it in cloth to build a Yoghurt Incubator, or in a sheet to carry hot milk.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Jar: Home-set yoghurt: a glass jar holds 1 L, a clay jar 2.5 L. Eat it from the jar a 250 ml portion at a time, or spoon portions into Empty Yoghurt Containers; the jar comes back with the last spoonful.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Act: A live culture grown on wheat. Add it to a Yoghurt Incubator to set one batch.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Emp: Wash it and fill it again with home-set yoghurt.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationDairy_Wra: Carries 5 litres of steamed milk from the Hearth and keeps it hot: about 15 C lost in an hour. Unwrap it when empty.
